Thank you for sharing more stories of the other continents, Adventurer.
I enjoyed talking with you too, Merimel.
strings.그런데 메디아 님이 종종 자리를 비우곤 하시는데, 무슨 위험한 일이 일어: Lady Medea has been away quite often lately. Something dangerous is happening, isn't it?
strings.음, 뭐라고 설명해야 하지…. 그래도 너무 걱정하지 말아요. 메디아 님하: Hmm, how do I explain... Try not to worry too much. Lady Medea and I will take care of it.
If you say everything will be all right...
strings.(메리멜이 환하게 웃으며 %s의 두손을 붙잡는다.): (Merimel smiles brightly and takes both of %s's hands.)
strings.괜찮겠죠? 칼리 족은 전부 모험가님을 믿어요. 신뢰하고 있으니까요. 필요: It will be, won't it? All of us in the Kali tribe believe in you. We trust you. If there's anything you need, please tell us.
strings.메리멜, 대화 중에 미안하다. 잠깐, %s에게 볼일이 있어서…. 아직 할: Sorry to interrupt, Merimel. I need a word with %s... If you haven't finished, I can wait.
strings.아냐. 내 이야기는 다 끝났어. 그런데 순찰은 다 끝났어?: No, we were just finishing. Have you finished your patrol?
Adrica seemed safe, so I came back.
strings.그러면 %s 님, 베이넌하고 대화 나누세요. 저는 재료 모은 것들 정리하: Then I'll leave you to talk with Beinan, %s. I'll go sort the materials I've gathered.
There's something important I need to tell you. Let's go to my usual spot by the village entrance.
strings.(무슨 말을 하려는 거지? 일단 가볼까?): (What could he want to say? I'd better go find out.)
You... seem to have been to a place called Knossos.
You may have heard my story before, during your visits to Kali Village.
Perhaps this will be the first time, perhaps the second. Either way, I'll tell you.
strings.어릴 적 나는 메리멜을 비롯해 마을 사람들과 함께였어도 늘 이질감을 느끼: As a child, I always felt out of place, even with Merimel and the others in the village.
strings.그러다 불길한 기억이 찾아와 날 괴롭혔지. 이런 내가 온전하게 남은 건: Then ominous memories began to torment me. Only Lady Medea's power kept me whole...
strings.데이모스 교단에 희생당한 일족의 기억과 그들의 '속박'에서 벗어나기 위해: Memories of my people sacrificed by the Deimos Order. Of myself running to escape their 'binding,' until my life force drained away and I collapsed...
strings.하지만, 다른 기억이 또 있는 것 같았다. 메디아 님과 네가 돌아온 후에: But I felt there were other memories, too. When you and Lady Medea returned, you carried a scent that filled me with a strange nostalgia.
I don't know why that name came to mind.
strings.저기, 베이넌…. 칼리 족은 크노소스하고 어떤 관련이 있는 거야?: Beinan... What connection does the Kali tribe have to Knossos?
strings.정확히는 알 수 없어. 내 기억과 칼리 족의 과거…. 나도 제대로 알고: I don't know for certain. My memories, our tribe's past... I want to understand them properly. I'm sure Lady Medea does, too.
strings.빛의 눈물을 구해다 주면 돼?: Should I bring you Tears of Light?
No. I need something from Knossos. Find a stone tablet engraved with a wing design. It must be somewhere important.
All right. I'll go to Knossos.
strings.(흠, 중요한 장소라면 심장의 기억, 아니면 아크로의 관일 텐데….): (Hmm. Somewhere important would be Memory of the Heart or Acro's Coffin...)
strings.(탈로스가 자주 찾아오라고 했는데, 한번 가볼까? 후우, 그럼 가보자.): (Talos told me to visit often. Should I try him? All right, let's go.)
You really are interested in me, aren't you? I didn't expect you back so soon.
You told me to visit and build trust. I wasn't exactly eager, but...
strings.내키든 내키지 않든 네가 내게서 필요한 것을 가져가기 위해 온 것은 부정: Eager or not, don't deny that you've come to get something you need from me.
strings.(은근 짜증 나네…. 그래도 만만하게 볼 상대는 아니야.): (He's getting on my nerves... Still, I shouldn't underestimate him.)
If you don't want to talk, so be it. I have weeds to pull. Goodbye.
strings.알았어요. 그러면 혹시 날개 문양이 새겨진 돌 같은 걸 본 적 없나요?: All right. Have you ever seen a stone engraved with a wing design?
strings.흠, 그게 왜 필요한 거지? 그 여자가 가지고 오라고 했나? 뭐, 상관없: Hmm. Why do you need that? Did that woman send you for it? Well, it doesn't matter.
Ask the cat woman trapped in Memory of the Heart to find it.
strings.그래, 그 여자. 운이 좋은지 희귀한 건 금방 찾아내는 타입이야. 그나저: Yes, her. She has a knack for finding rare things. Good luck, perhaps. She's making quite a racket, though.
strings.밖으로 나오려고 저 안에서 난리를 피우는데, 시끄럽네. 수인왕이고 저: She's causing havoc in there trying to get out. So noisy. If she and the Beastman King ever get out again, they'll certainly try to kill me.
strings.외지인에게 일일이 이야기하고 싶진 않아. 여긴 여기대로 사정이 있는 거니: I don't care to explain every detail to an outsider. We have our own circumstances here.
What are you waiting for? Get going. Visit Memory of the Heart before she smashes it to pieces.
strings.(나무 위에 앉아서 누워있던 파시파에가 %s의 모습을 보더니 반가운듯 뛰: (Pasiphae, lounging in a tree, spots %s and jumps down eagerly.)
...I want to leave, but I can't find a way out. So I'm just playing around in here. Maybe the answer will come to me while I play?
strings.우리 자기도 못 보고 지루해. 여기저기 다 뒤지고 그냥 잘까 했는데, 네: I'm bored, and I can't even see my darling. I'd searched everywhere and was about to take a nap, and then you arrived.
Not yet. But I'll do everything I can.
I wasn't expecting much anyway. If it were easy, I'd have been out long ago.
strings.그리고 그놈을 찾아서…. 나머지는 말하지 않아도 알겠지?: Then I'd find that man and... You can guess the rest, right?
strings.(파시파에가 씨익 웃으며 두 자루의 단검을 들어 보인다.): (Pasiphae grins and holds up a pair of daggers.)
I've come looking for something I need.
strings.심장 조각은 더 없는데, 그거 말고 뭐가 필요해? 그거 여신님한테 필요한: I don't have any more heart fragments. What else do you need? Is it for the goddess?
strings.(파시파에에게 이야기해도 될 것 같아 칼리 족과 상황을 간략하게 설명한다: (Deciding it should be safe to tell Pasiphae, you briefly explain the Kali tribe's situation.)
strings.크노소스를 기억하려는 인간이 나와 비슷하다는 거지?: So the person trying to remember Knossos is like me?
strings.내 꼬리? 이거 가짜야. 떼고 붙일 수 있어! 후후후, 우리 자기가 만들: My tail? It's fake. I can take it off and put it back on! Hehehe. My darling made it for me.
strings.뭘 그렇게 놀라? 하여튼 너! 날개 문양 석판이 필요한 거지? 그거 나한: What's so surprising? Anyway! You need a tablet with a wing design, right? I've got one! I'll give it to you!
strings.그런데 그냥은 안 줄거양. 심심했으니 잘 됐어. 나하고 싸우자! 죽지 않: But not for free. Perfect timing, I was bored. Fight me! Just enough that neither of us dies! Please, please?
strings.그냥 주면 재미없으니까 심장의 기억 끝에서 기다릴게~. 거기서 나랑 만나: Just handing it over would be no fun. I'll wait at the far end of Memory of the Heart. Meet me there and let's fight!
strings.(파시파에가 두 눈을 반짝이더니 빠른 걸음으로 심장의 기억 안으로 들어간: (Eyes sparkling, Pasiphae hurries deeper into Memory of the Heart.)
strings.잘 놀았당. 내가 떨어뜨린 석판 잘 챙겼지?: That was fun! You picked up the tablet I dropped, right?
A good run around has cheered me up. I was feeling so miserable.
Thank you... for helping my people.
The Kali tribe really are your people? But this is a land of beastmen...
strings.너 수인이 뭐라 생각해?: What do you think a beastman is?
strings.인간처럼 걷지만, 동물의 모습을 한 그런 존재라고 알고 있는 거지?: Something that walks like a human but looks like an animal, right?
strings.크리드의 주민은 두 부류야. 동물의 얼굴로 인간처럼 걷는, 인간과 별 다: There are two kinds of people in Creed. Those who walk like humans but have animal faces, and those who look almost human except for their animal ears...
strings.그저 모습이 너희 같은 일반 인간과 조금, 아주 조금 다른 것뿐인데, 프: We only look a little, just a little, different from ordinary humans like you. I don't know why the humans of Freios make such a fuss...
No need to look so serious. I'm used to it.
strings.하여튼 그거 필요한 사람에게 줘. 다음에 또 와, 알았지? 혹시라도 우리: Anyway, give that to whoever needs it. Come back again, okay? And if you happen to see my darling, tell him I miss him!
I will. See you later, Pasiphae.
strings.아, 맞다. 석판 하나 더 있는데…. 그걸로 되면 된 거고, 아니면 한: Oh, right. I have another tablet... If that one's enough, good. If not, they'll come back. Hehe.
I wonder what my darling is doing...
